title: FirnR: Simulate Polar Snow and Firn Cores

description: R package providing tools to work with and simulate polar firn and ice cores, with a focus on the isotopic composition. Methods implemented include the depth-dependent modelling of firn density and stable water isotopologue diffusion length; conversion of ice core depth scales; estimation of firn parameters and their changes over depth; simulation of temporal changes of firn isotope profiles from advection, depth scale compression and diffusion; and forward simulation of isotope profiles based on meteorological data.
